title: Fibre dimensions are preserved by base change
statement: Let f:X\to S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let g:S'\to S be a morphism of schemes, and form the cartesian square X'=X\times_S S' [def-pc-fibre-product] with projection f':X'\to S' [def-pc-base-change]. For x'\in X' with image x\in X, put s'=f'(x') and s=f(x). Then the fibre (X')_{s'} [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is the base change of X_s along the residue-field map \kappa(s)\to\kappa(s') [def-weil-residue-field], and the local dimensions [def-kun-dimension] agree: \dim_{x'}((X')_{s'})=\dim_x(X_s).

proof.text: Since s = g(s'), the morphism Spec \kappa(s') -> S' -> S factors as Spec \kappa(s') -> Spec \kappa(s) -> S through the residue-field map \kappa(s) -> \kappa(s') [def-weil-residue-field]. By the definitions of fibre and fibre product [def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-pc-fibre-product], (X')_{s'} = (X x_S S') x_{S'} Spec \kappa(s') = X x_S Spec \kappa(s') = (X x_S Spec \kappa(s)) x_{Spec \kappa(s)} Spec \kappa(s') = X_s x_{Spec \kappa(s)} Spec \kappa(s'). The middle equality is the transitivity (pasting) of fibre products, supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-cartesian-square-pasting].

The morphism X_s -> Spec \kappa(s) is locally of finite type by [lem-weil-pbc-lft-base-change], applied to f and Spec \kappa(s) -> S. Choose an affine open U = Spec A of X_s containing x, with A a finite type \kappa(s)-algebra; its inverse image U' = Spec(A \otimes_{\kappa(s)} \kappa(s')) is an open neighbourhood of x' in the residue-field base change. The dimension at a point is computed on any open neighbourhood [def-kun-dimension], and [lem-weil-pbc-dimension-at-point-field-extension] gives dim_{x'} U' = dim_x U because the prime of A \otimes_{\kappa(s)} \kappa(s') at x' lies over the prime of A at x. Hence dim_{x'}((X')_{s'}) = dim_x(X_s).

lean.statement: theorem fibre_dimension_after_base_change {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (g : S' ⟶ S) (x' : ↥(Limits.pullback f g)) : let f' : Limits.pullback f g ⟶ S' := Limits.pullback.snd f g let x : X := Limits.pullback.fst f g x' let s' : S' := f' x' let s : S := g s' (∃ e : f'.fiber s' ≅ Limits.pullback (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s) (Spec.map (g.residueFieldMap s')), e.hom ≫ Limits.pullback.fst _ _ ≫ f.fiberι s = f'.fiberι s' ≫ Limits.pullback.fst f g ∧ e.hom ≫ Limits.pullback.snd _ _ = f'.fiberToSpecResidueField s') ∧ f x = s ∧ topologicalKrullDimAt (f'.asFiber x') = topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber x)
